top_signals.title: Renewed U.S.-Iran tension could push oil past $100: Rapidan Energy
top_signals.summary: Bob McNally predicts that both Brent and West Texas Intermediate futures will jump above $100.

top_signals.title: Decline in Markets as Asia Hit By Major Tech Selloff
top_signals.summary: Key Asian markets were hit with a major tech selloff following an overnight drop in US technology shares. Bloomberg's reporters as well as veteran tech investor Dan Niles take stock of some of the key moments. (Source: Bloomberg)
